narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Seven figs cannot make a rectangle at all, because seven does not split nicely.
<bookmark mark='row'/>But look at one row of seven figs. It is a rectangle that is seven wide and one tall.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A single row counts as a rectangle, so the question is how many rectangles there are.
